summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting any proposal to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizing the program's role in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education.

claims.argument: E-Rate support is recurring cost for maintaining network infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Troy R3 School District has received $583,856 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $116,771 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
